correctness.rationale: The generator is explicitly reconstructed for every monomial. Synchronous coupling yields unique stationarity because energy is nonexpansive under deterministic segments and reset, and any fixed reset-free interval is uniformly contractive; such intervals occur independently with positive frequency. Conditional Gaussian covariances are bounded by equilibrium, justifying fourth moments. Solving all three second-degree and five fourth-degree stationary equations yields alpha_X=6 k r/D; exact symbolic scripts replay these identities and the derivative. Its derivative numerator is strictly decreasing from positive to negative infinity, so there is one global maximizer. Velocity moment ratio and limiting behavior follow algebraically.

value.rationale: A nontrivial experimentally interpretable fluctuation observable is exactly optimized over every positive Poisson reset rate for all positive trap/friction/temperature parameters. The unique rate is determined by a sharp cubic threshold; normalized spatial non-Gaussianity vanishes both without resetting and under arbitrarily rapid velocity stopping, while velocity non-Gaussianity remains finite. This marks a structural separation of hidden and observed fluctuation physics and is not a cheap sign check or arbitrary parameter slice.
